description:
Discover indexed arXiv papers using titles, authors and abstracts to assess relevance.
Prefer an English research topic or question, preserving important entities and phrases.
For broad questions, consider distinct research dimensions and query each as useful.
Independent queries can run concurrently; 5-10 concurrent requests are recommended
for larger batches. Results can complement findings from other research tools and
sources for broader coverage.
scout_available indicates whether deeper paper-based analysis can be requested
with get_scout; choose further reading according to the evidence needed.
Use from/to as YYYY-MM-DD UTC dates with both days included.
Provide both or neither; each dated query covers at most one calendar month,
with dates available from 2025-08-01 onward. Omit both for all indexed dates.
For timeouts, wait at least retry_after_seconds when supplied before retrying.

from.description: First included UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. The database supports 2025-08-01 onward. Provide both from and to, or omit both to search all supported content.
from.title: From

query.description: Prefer English natural-language research topics or questions; keep important entities and technical phrases.
query.title: Query

to.description: Last included UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD; the entire day is included. Provide both from and to. At most one calendar month after from; same-day queries valid.
to.title: To

name: search_papers
title: Search papers
